result.title: PrismRestore: A Compact Restoration Toolbox for Agentic Image Restoration
result.summary: Agentic image restoration composes operations to handle mixed degradations, yet its toolbox often requires storing multiple restoration networks. We propose PrismRestore, which constructs a compact bank of callable restoration actions from a single frozen all-in-one model. Our approach builds on task-dependent yet overlapping channel responses in the shared model. An offline task-prior search uses activation and gradient statistics to group channels with similar response profiles, then searches task-specific modulation coefficients over non-representative channels while leaving representative channels unmodulated. The resulting prior bank enables explicit action selection and composition without additional restoration backbones or task-specific adapter modules. A state-conditioned policy learns to compose these actions using Group Relative Policy Optimization. Its objective separately normalizes fidelity and perceptual feedback within groups of trajectories sampled for the same input, and combines terminal evaluation with return-to-go derived from stepwise quality changes. Experiments on synthetic composite-degradation and real-world multi-task benchmarks show improvements over the evaluated all-in-one baselines and restoration quality competitive with multi-model agents. PrismRestore achieves these results with a single restoration backbone and faster inference than the evaluated agentic baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 PrismRestore，用单个冻结的 all-in-one 复原模型，通过通道响应分组与离线任务先验搜索构建可调用的动作库，并用状态条件策略与 GRPO 学习动作组合，避免存储多个复原网络。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按通道响应聚类划分可复用子能力、以及按同输入轨迹分组归一化并对逐步质量变化做回报分配的训练方式，可能为 LVR 中 latent 子空间筛选与多步推理的贡献分配提供可核查线索。
